content_blocks.label: clause_1._Definition_of_Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means any information, whether oral, written, or electronic, disclosed by the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Obligation_of_Confidentiality
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall not disclose, use, or permit others to use the Confidential Information without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Term
content_blocks.text: This agreement shall remain in effect until the termination of the relationship between the Parties as set forth in Section 4.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 20th day of July 2024.
